description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableDittoHeaders class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers package. It verifies immutability, header creation, JSON serialization, and header manipulation behaviors, targeting the implementation of immutable headers used within the Ditto framework.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoHeadersTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ImmutableDittoHeaders class ensuring its immutability, correct header handling, JSON serialization, and other behaviors.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableDittoHeaders instances are immutable using MutabilityDetector assertions.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies proper implementation of hashCode() and equals() for ImmutableDittoHeaders.

methods.name: settingAllKnownHeadersWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests setting all known headers and verifies the resulting header map.

methods.name: createInstanceOfValidHeaderMapWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that creating an ImmutableDittoHeaders instance from a valid header map works correctly.

methods.name: createInstanceOfValidHeaderJsonObjectWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that creating headers from a JsonObject produces the expected header map.

methods.name: createInstanceContainingArbitraryKeyValuePair
methods.description: Checks creation with arbitrary key-value pairs.

methods.name: getCorrelationIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the correlation ID retrieval.

methods.name: getSchemaVersionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates the schema version retrieval.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the authorization context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that authorization subjects are correctly returned.

methods.name: getReadSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies read subjects retrieval.

methods.name: getReadGrantedSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks granted read subjects.

methods.name: getRevokedSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies revoked subjects retrieval.

methods.name: isResponseRequiredIsTrueByDefault
methods.description: Tests that responseRequired defaults to true.

methods.name: isResponseRequiredReturnsFalseLikeSet
methods.description: Verifies responseRequired if set to false.

methods.name: isResponseRequiredReturnsTrueLikeSet
methods.description: Verifies responseRequired if set to true.

methods.name: isResponseRequiredStaysFalseEvenIfRequiredAckLabelsAreSet
methods.description: Ensures responseRequired remains false when acknowledgement labels are set.

methods.name: isDryRunIsFalseByDefault
methods.description: Checks default value of dryRun.

methods.name: isDryRunReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies dryRun if set to true.

methods.name: getRequestedAckLabelsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Retrieves acknowledgement requests.

methods.name: timeoutIsSerializedAsString
methods.description: Checks timeout serialization to JSON.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersToPutReturnsEmptySet
methods.description: Verifies that headers to put are empty if none are set.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersToPutReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks retrieval of metadata headers to put.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates JSON serialization of headers.

methods.name: removesDuplicatedAuthSubjectsFromHeaderMap
methods.description: Tests removal of duplicate authorization subjects.

methods.name: removesDuplicatedAuthSubjectsFromJsonRepresentation
methods.description: Checks that duplicated auth subjects are deduplicated in JSON.

methods.name: putThrowsUnsupportedOperationException
methods.description: Verifies that put operation throws an exception to enforce immutability.

methods.name: putAllThrowsUnsupportedOperationException
methods.description: Verifies that putAll operation throws an exception.

methods.name: removeThrowsUnsupportedOperationException
methods.description: Verifies that remove operation throws an exception.

methods.description: Verifies that clear operation throws an exception.

methods.description: Checks that entry set is unmodifiable.

methods.name: allKnownHeadersAreTested
methods.description: Confirms that all known headers are included in the test coverage.

methods.name: tryToCheckIfEntriesSizeIsGreaterThanNegativeLong
methods.description: Tests that negative size comparison throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: entriesSizeIsGreaterThanZeroIfHeadersAreNotEmpty
methods.description: Verifies size comparison for non-empty headers.

methods.name: entriesSizeIsNotGreaterThanZeroIfHeadersAreEmpty

methods.description: Tests truncating headers to fit within a specified size limit.
